li.p: System operation in the event of a traffic accident
Connection with the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP)

conbody.p: The Emergency Call (eCall) System automatically makes an emergency call to the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) to request appropriate rescue operations in the event of a vehicle accident.

For the purpose of providing appropriate emergency services response and support, the Emergency Call (eCall) System automatically transmits the accident data to the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) when a traffic accident is detected.

In this case, the emergency call cannot be hung up by pressing the SOS button and the Emergency Call (eCall) System remains connected until the emergency service officer, receiving the call, disconnects the emergency call.
In minor traffic accidents, the Emergency Call (eCall) System may not execute an emergency call. However, an emergency call may be made manually by pressing the SOS button.

note.p: Operation of the system is impossible in case of absence of cellular transmission and GPS and Galileo signals.
